title: The People Who Stay
author: Shaina
text:
Handa na sana akong sumugal,
kahit alam kong maaari na naman akong masaktan nang tunay.
Handa na sana akong hayaang puso ko’y muling magmahal,
ngunit sa dulo, pinili ko na lang muling umurong at umatras.
Handa na sana akong tumaya,
kahit takot ang kasama sa bawat hakbang na aking ginagawa.
Ngunit habang papalapit ako sa posibilidad na tayo,
mas lalo kong naramdaman ang takot na baka mawala rin ako.
Kaya huwag na lang pala,
baka hindi lahat ng pagkakataon ay para sa ating dalawa.
May mga damdaming mas mabuting manatiling lihim,
kaysa muling maging sugat ang minsang pinangarap kong
paghilom.
Dahil kahit handa na akong sumugal sa iyo,
may bahagi pa rin ng sarili kong ayaw nang malunod sa gulo.
Kaya sa pagkakataong ito, sarili ko muna ang pipiliin ko—
kahit ang ibig sabihin nito'y kailangan kitang bitawan bago pa
man maging tayo.

title: A Heart Afraid to Try
author: Shaina
text:
I don't really know how to say this without making it sound heavier than it is, but I just want you to know that you meant something to me.
Maybe I didn't always show it. Maybe there were times when I pulled away, became quiet,
or made things more complicated than they needed to be. It wasn't because I didn't care.
Sometimes, I cared too much, and that scared me.
I've always had this fear that one day you'd get tired of me, get bored, and leave me behind. So before that could happen, a part of me kept trying to protect itself by keeping a distance.
But despite all of that, I'm grateful for the time we spent talking, laughing, and simply being there for each other. You became someone I got used to having around, someone whose presence mattered more than I probably admitted.
And now, we're not talking anymore. We're back to being strangers, but this time, we're strangers with memories. Memories of conversations, little moments, laughter, and a version of us that once knew each other in a way strangers never could.
I don't know where life will take us from here, and maybe we're really meant to remain strangers from now on. I won't force my way back into your life. I just hope that someday,
when you remember me, you'll remember that there was someone who genuinely cared about you.
I never regretted knowing you.
And if I ever seemed afraid of you, I think the truth is—I was just afraid of losing you.
So this isn't me asking you to come back. It's just me leaving behind the words I never got to say.
Thank you for being a part of my life, even if, in the end, we became strangers again.
This time, strangers with memories.

title: What My Eyes Say
author: Shaina
text:
If you can't see the sadness in my eyes,
then perhaps you haven't been looking close enough.
I may laugh as though nothing ever hurts,
but my eyes have never been good at hiding what my lips
conceal.
I've learned to make “Im fine” sound convincing,
to smile even when something inside me aches.
I can turn my pain into ordinary conversations,
and carry heavy things without letting my hands shake.
But if you've truly been observing me,
you'd notice how my eyes grow distant when I'm tired,
how my laughter sometimes comes a little too quickly,
as if I'm trying to outrun whatever I'm feeling inside.
So if you ask me how I am, look at me a little longer.
Maybe you'll find the answer I was too afraid to say.
Because if you can't find the sadness hiding in my eyes,
then maybe you never really noticed me in the first place.

title: The Space You Left
author: Shaina
text:
What if I find the love I feared,
someone who stays, someone sincere,
but I become afraid to let them in,
and lose something beautiful before it can begin?
What if they leave, as I always fear?
What if 'm never brave enough to keep them near?
What if my heart, so used to goodbye,
keeps choosing distance just to survive?

title: After We Said Goodbye
author: Shaina
text:
They asked me how to unlove someone,
and I wondered if such a thing could ever truly be done.
How do you erase a heart you once called home,
or forget the soul that once made you feel less alone?
I believe you can never really unlove someone,
you only learn to live when their presence is gone.
At first, their absence aches in places no one can see,
until you slowly learn that they can be gone and you can still be free.
You get used to the silence where their voice used to stay,
to reaching for your phone, then putting it away.
You learn that missing them doesn't mean you have to return,
and some memories are meant to remain, not be relearned.
Maybe the love doesn't disappear with time,
it simply becomes quieter, softer, less inclined
to ask them to come back or beg them to stay,
until you can love what once was and still walk away.
Maybe healing isn’t forgetting their name,
or pretending what you shared was never real or worth the pain.
It's remembering them without wishing for yesterday,
and carrying what they left behind without letting it carry you away.
So if you ask me how to unlove someone,
I’ll tell you honestly: I don’t think it can be done.
You just get used to the life you have to live without them,
until their absence no longer feels like losing yourself again.

title: A Love I Couldn’t Say
author: Shaina
text:
I believe you can never really unlove someone.
You just learn to get used to not having them around—
to their absence becoming part of your ordinary days,
until the silence where they used to be no longer feels so loud.
You learn not to look for them in every familiar place,
not to wonder what they're doing or if they still remember
you.
You learn to live with the space they left behind,
even when a small part of your heart still remembers them.
Maybe love doesn't always disappear when someone leaves.
Sometimes, you simply learn how to carry it more quietly.
You stop waiting, stop reaching, stop asking them to stay,
and slowly understand that loving someone doesn’t always
mean having them in your life.
Perhaps that is what healing really is—
not forgetting, not erasing, not pretending you never cared,
but getting used to a life where they are no longer around
until missing them becomes something you can live with.

title: Behind My Walls
author: Shaina
text:
I never knew my heart was tired,
until your gentleness brought tears to my eyes.
Not because you gave me another wound to hide,
but because you touched the ones I had carried inside.
I spent so long pretending I didn’t need,
teaching my heart to stay guarded and unseen.
I built my walls from every hurt I survived,
thinking being alone was the safest way to stay alive.
Then you came, so gentle and sincere,
never forcing your way past the walls built from fear.
You made me feel safe without asking me to explain,
and somehow, your kindness made me want to feel again.
That’s when I realized why I cried that night,
your tenderness made something in me feel right.
For the first time, my heart could finally breathe,
and after all those years, it found the peace it needed in your
Gentleness.

title: The Way I Feel
author: Shaina
text:
Maybe I had feelings before you knew,
before your heart ever learned to feel them too,
I kept them quietly beneath my skin,
afraid of where loving you might begin.
Maybe I loved you in ways I couldn't say,
in every little moment I chose to stay,
in words I swallowed before they could fall,
in wanting you close, yet fearing it all.
My heart had already chosen your name,
while my mind kept warning me not to play this game,
because the heart only knows how to want,
while the mind remembers the wounds that love brought.
I wanted to hold you, but I feared I'd lose you,
wanted to stay, but feared what love might do,
so I stood at the edge of everything we could be,
loving you quietly, while choosing not to leap.
And maybe you'll never know how deep it went,
how much of my silence was never indifference,
I wasn't empty, nor did I never care—
I was simply too afraid to find out if love could stay there.
Maybe I loved you before you knew it was true,
maybe my heart had already belonged to you,
but some feelings are born with nowhere to go—
and some hearts love deeply, yet still whisper, no.

title: A Place in My Heart
author: Shaina
text:
How dare I crave for love when I have nothing to give,
How dare I ask someone to stay when I forget how to live,
How dare I seek a gentle heart when mince is full of scars,
When I still lose myself beneath these endless, restless stars.
How dare I ask for softness when my world is still so loud,
When every part of me is tangled in a restless crowd,
I want someone to hold me, to make the chaos cease,
Yet I haven't learned to give myself the same peace.
Maybe I should build myself before I ask to be adored,
Gather every broken piece I’ve left scattered on the floor,
Learn to stand without depending on another’s embrace,
And learn that being whole begins with giving myself grace.
Maybe I need to be enough before I ask someone to choose,
To know that I can stay even when I have everything to lose,
For love should be a meeting, not a desperate plea to stay,
And I should choose myself before I give myself away.

title: Maybe It Was Love
author: Shaina
text:
I think I finally know what love is,
not in grand promises, but in the quiet moments of peace.
It’s in the way you hold my heart with care,
as if you know how much it has learned to fear.
I used to think love had to be something grand,
someone who could meet every impossible standard I had planned.
But maybe my heart was never asking for much from the start—
just someone gentle enough to hold my guarded heart.
Maybe love is feeling safe enough to be soft,
without wondering when that softness will come at a cost.
It’s being seen without having to explain every part of me,
and finally breathing freely in the presence of someone who understands me.
And maybe that’s why I guarded my heart so tight,
because I knew one day, someone's kindness might feel right.
I was afraid of mistaking tenderness for something true,
until I realized that everything I had been searching for
was quietly leading me to you.
Now I understand why love never felt easy before,
why my heart kept closing every time someone came to my door.
Maybe I was never waiting for someone perfect or new—
I was waiting for a love that felt like peace,
and after all the years I spent wondering what love could be,
I finally found it in you.

title: A Smile That Hides
author: Shaina
text:
I have so many feelings I never know how to say,
so I swallow every word and let the silence stay.
When something hurts, I tell myself it’s small,
that maybe I'm just sensitive, maybe I'm wrong after all.
I ask myself, “Who am I to complain?”
“Do I even have the right to admit this pain?”
So I laugh like nothing happened, smile like fm okay,
while every unsaid feeling quietly grows heavier each day.
I'm afraid they'll never understand what I mean,
or think [m making something bigger than it seems.
So instead of saying, “That hurt me,” I choose to disappear,
hiding every trembling truth behind a calm and careless
exterior.
Maybe I've become too good at keeping things inside,
at turning every wound into something I can hide.
I keep saying I'm fine until even I believe it’s true,
while the words I never said keep hurting me in ways no one
knew.

title: A Life Without You
author: Shaina
text:
Sa apat na sulok ng kwartong tahimik,
doon ko ikinukubli ang pusong pilit,
bawat hikbi’y nilulunod sa gabi,
habang ako’y ngumingiti sa mundong mapanliniang lagi.
Sa unang sulok, naroon ang pangamba,
sa ikalaway mga luhang di ko maipakita,
sa ikatlo'y mga salitang hindi ko masambit,
sa ikaapat, akoy yakap ang sarili sa gitna ng sakit.
Dito walang tanong kung bakit ako pagod,
walang matang huhusga sa bawat pag-ikot,
dito ko hinahayaang bumagsak ang bigat,
at unti-unting pulutin ang sarili kong wasak.
Sapagkat sa apat na sulok na aking kanlungan,
natutuhan kong hindi lahat ng sakit ay kailangang
ipagsigawan,
minsan, sapat nang ako’'y manatili at huminga,
hanggang ang kwartong tahimik ay muli kong matawag na
tahanan.

title: When We Became Strangers
author: Shaina
text:
Sa aking unan ko ibinubuhos ang bigat ng gabi,
Mga luhang sa iba’y pilit kong itinatago palagi,
Dito ko ipinapahinga ang pusong sugatan,
At mga salitang hindi masabi’y tahimik na pinanghahawakan.
Kapag ang mundo'y tahimik at tulog na ang lahat,
kaw ang saksi sa mga luhang kusang pumapatak,
Wala kang tanong sa sakit na aking dinadala,
Yakap mo lamang ang tahimik kong pag-iisa.
lang gabi na rin kitang ginawang aking sandalan,
Sa tuwing ang dibdib ko'y puno ng alinlangan,
Sa iyong lambot ko hinahanap ang kaunting ginhawa,
Kapag ang sarili kong yakap ay hindi na sapat para sa aking
pagkabahala.
At pagsikat ng araw, muli kong itatago ang sakit,
Muling haharap sa mundo na may ngiting pilit,
Ngunit ikaw ang nakaaalam sa gabing ako'y nanghina,
Ang unan kong tahimik na kasama sa bawat luhang bumaba.

title: Learning to Let Go
author: Shaina
text:
Kahit mainit ang gabi, hindi kita kayang bitawan,
Dahil sa piling mo’y may tahimik na kapanatagan,
Sa bawat yakap mo, nababawasan ang aking pangamba,
Parang kahit sandali, ligtas ako sa mundong magulot
masalimuot na talaga.
Kapag pagod ang isip at mabigat ang dibdib,
Ikaw ang hinahanap ko sa bawat saglit,
Hindi man kita kailangan dahil sa lamig ng gabi,
Hinahanap ka pa rin ng sarili kong sanay sa iyong tabi.
lang gabi mo nang kasama ang aking pangungulila,
Mga luhang tahimik na ayaw kong makita ng iba,
Sa ilalim mo’y malaya akong maging mahina,
Walang kailangang itago, walang kailangang ipaliwanag pa.
Kaya kahit pawisan at mainit ang paligid,
Mananatili ka pa rin sa aking tabi kahit saglit,
Sapagkat hindi lamig ang dahilan kung bakit kita niyayakap,
Kundi ang kapanatagang sa iyo ko lamang nahahanap.

title: The Last Thing I Kept
author: Shaina
text:
Sa bawat ikot mo’y may hanging dumadampi,
At sa init ng gabi, unti-unti akong napapawi,
Ngunit higit sa lamig na iyong ibinibigay,
Ang iyong ingay ang takot kong unti-unting tinataboy palayo
sa malay.
Sa gabing ang paligid ay lubhang tahimik,
Ikaw ang tunog na aking hinahanap sa bawat saglit,
Sapagkat sa ingay na iyong marahang ibinibigay,
Hindi purong katahimikan ang aking naririnig sa buhay.
Kapag ang isip ko’'y ayaw nang tumigil,
Ang iyong ugong ang nagsisilbing munting awit sa dilim,
Hindi nito binubura ang bigat na nadarama,
Ngunit kahit paano, hindi ko nararamdamang nag-iisa.
Kaya kahit simpleng bintilador ka lamang sa aking tabi,
May ginhawang sa iyo ko natatagpuan gabi-gabi,
Sa iyong hangin at ingay, panatag akong nakahihimlay,
Dahil hindi man katahimikan, may tunog kang nagsasabing may
kasama pa rin ako sa buhay.

title: Alone With My Thoughts
author: Shaina
text:
Something felt different,
though neither of us ever said what had changed.
The conversations were still there,
but somehow, they no longer felt the same.
There was a distance I could feel but never name,
a quiet shift hidden between familiar words.
Maybe nothing happened all at once,
maybe some things simply fade before we notice they're gone.
Then time kept moving, quietly and without asking,
and the distance between us grew a little more each day.
No doors slammed, no final words were spoken,
yet somehow, the space between us learned how to stay.
And somewhere along the way, something else began,
So quietly that its beginning remains unknown.
I never knew when the first step was taken,
only that by the time I noticed, we were already far from
where we began.
Maybe that is what stays with me the most,
not the ending, but the uncertainty of when it changed.
How something once full of possibility became a silence,
and how time let distance swallow what we never got to name.

title: Your Empty Place
author: Shaina
text:
Sa umaga, ito ang una kong binubuksan,
Hinahayaan ang liwanag na pumasok sa aking tahanan,
Madalas ay hindi ko na rin ito muling sinasarado,
Dahil sa gabi, malamig na hangin ang kusang pumapasok dito.
Tuwing dapit-hapon, pinagmamasdan ko ang langit,
Habang ang araw ay unti-unting nawawala sa aking paningin,
At kapag maliwanag ang buwan sa kalangitan,
Sinag nito’y tahimik na pumapasok sa aking tahanan.
Sa bawat hanging dumaraan, may ginhawang dala,
Lalo na kapag gabi at payapa ang paligid sa labas,
Wala man itong salita upang ako’y aliwin,
Ngunit sa bawat simoy, gumagaan ang aking damdamin.
Kaya hinahayaan ko itong bukas hanggang sa gabi,
Para salubungin ang hangin na malamig at banayad sa tabi,
Sa simpleng pagbukas nito sa bawat umaga,
May liwanag, hangin, at munting saya akong nakukuha.

title: Where We Left Off
author: Shaina
text:
Sa piling mo, may payapang nadarama,
Parang sa magulong mundo, ikaw ang pahinga;
Hindi ko kailangang humingi ng higit pa,
Sapat nang sa tabi mo, panatag ang aking kaluluwa.
Hindi man laging madali ang bawat araw,
Sayo, kahit tahimik, may ligayang sumisibol;
Sa simpleng presensya mo, gumagaan ang mundo,
At sa yakap ng sandali, nakakalimot ang puso.
Hindi kita minamahal dahil may kulang sa akin,
Kundi dahil sa'yo, mas buo ang aking damdamin;
Wala akong kailangang hanapin sa ibang tanawin,
Dahil sa piling mo, gusto kong manatiling akin.
Kung ito man ang pag-ibig na matagal kong hinintay,
Hahayaan kong lumalim, dahan-dahan, walang sablay;
Hindi ko kailangan ng higit pa sa iyong kamay,
Dahil sa'yo, minamahal at kontento na ako sa buhay.

title: A Goodbye I Still Feel
author: Shaina
text:
Sa simpleng ginagawa mo, kinikilig ako nang sobra,
Hindi tulad ng sinasabing may paru-paro sa tiyan nila.
Walang engrandeng salita, walang kailangang ipakita,
Sapat na ang maliliit mong paraan para ako’y mapasaya.
Minsan, isang tingin mo lang, puso ko’y nagugulo,
Isang simpleng kilos mo, may ngiti na agad ako.
Hindi ko man maipaliwanag kung bakit ganito,
Basta kapag ikaw, grabe ka, kinikilig ako.
Hindi ko hinihingi ang mga bagay na marangya,
Dahil sa munting ginagawa mo, sapat na, sinta.
Sa bawat simpleng sandali na kasama ka,
May kilig na tahimik, pero ramdam hanggang kaluluwa.
Siguro ganito pala kapag tunay na nahuhulog,
Hindi kailangang maingay para puso’'y matulog.
Sa'yo, kahit simple, may ligayang bumabalot,
At sa bawat ginagawa mo, puso ko’'y kusang sumusunod.

title: A Place Called Home
author: Shaina
text:
Sa tinagal-tagal ng panahong Iumipas sa buhay ko,
Marami mang dumaan, wala akong piniling maging akin nang
buo.
Ngunit sa’yo, may kakaibang lambing ang puso,
Na parang ngayon ko lang natutunang mahulog nang ganito.
Hindi ko inakalang darating ang ganitong pagkakataon,
Na may isang taong magiging tahanan ng aking emosyon.
Sa simpleng kilos mo, may kilig at kapanatagan,
At sa piling mo, natutong magmahal nang walang alinlangan.
Siguro ikaw ang dahilan kung bakit ngayon ko lang
naramdaman,
Ang pag-ibig na hindi ko kailangang pilitin 0 pag-isipan.
Sa tinagal-tagal, sa'yo lang ako naging ganito,
Kaya kung ito'y pag-ibig, ayoko nang tumakbo.
Hindi ko man alam kung saan tayo dadalhin ng panahon,
Sa ngayon, sap
